metadata.question: Was the area covered by solar panels in the Bhadla Solar Park in Rajasthan greater than 7,000 hectares in January 2022?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Bhadla Solar Park, Rajasthan, India (approximately 27.5°N, 71.9°E) - Time: January 2022 - Collection: Sentinel-2 (10m resolution) or Landsat 8/9 (30m resolution) for visual/NDVI analysis - Need to identify solar panels - they typically have very low NDVI, high reflectance in visible bands 2. Masking strategy: - Should mask clouds to get clear view of solar panels - Solar panels have distinctive spectral signature: low NDVI (similar to built-up areas), high reflectance 3. Logic: - Calculate area of pixels matching solar panel characteristics - Compare to 7,000 hectares (70 km²) - Valid zero would mean no solar panels detected (unlikely for Bhadla) - Null/Error would be C3 - Need to ensure we have valid imagery and pixels after masking ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define Bhadla Solar Park location (approximate center and buffer) const bhadlaCenter = ee.Geometry.Point([71.9, 27.5]); const studyArea = bhadlaCenter.buffer(8000); // 8km radius to cover the park // 2. Time period const startDate = '2022-01-01'; const endDate = '2022-01-31'; // 3. Load Sentinel-2 data let collection = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(studyArea) .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 30)); const collectionSize = collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Sentinel-2 images found: ${collectionSize}`); if (collectionSize === 0) { // Try Landsat 8 as fallback collection = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(studyArea) .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 30)); const landsatSize = collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Fallback Landsat 8 images: ${landsatSize}`); if (landsatSize === 0) { console.log('No imagery available for January 2022'); console.log('C1'); return; } } // 4. Create composite and identify solar panels const composite = collection.median(); // Calculate NDVI for Sentinel-2 const ndvi = composite.normalizedDifference(['B8', 'B4']).rename('NDVI'); // Solar panels typically have: // - Very low NDVI (< 0.1, often negative) // - High reflectance in visible bands const solarMask = ndvi.lt(0.15); // 5. Calculate area const pixelArea = solarMask.multiply(ee.Image.pixelArea()); const stats = pixelArea.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: studyArea, scale: 100, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const totalAreaM2 = stats.get('NDVI').getInfo(); if (totalAreaM2 === null || totalAreaM2 === undefined) { console.log('Calculation failed - no valid result'); console.log('C3'); return; } // 6. Count valid pixels const pixelCount = solarMask.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: studyArea, scale: 100, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI').getInfo(); console.log(`Valid pixels analyzed: ${pixelCount}`); if (pixelCount === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after processing'); console.log('C2'); return; } // 7. Convert to hectares and compare const areaHectares = totalAreaM2 / 10000; const threshold = 7000; console.log(`Total low-NDVI area (solar panels): ${areaHectares.toFixed(2)} hectares`); console.log(`Threshold: ${threshold} hectares`); if (areaHectares > threshold) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
